description.narrative: Malawi - Natural Resource Management Project - ENRM Action Plan Activity: MCC Funding will support the development and implementation of an integrated set of activities, acceptable to MCC, aimed at improving environmental and natural resources management (ENRM) in the Shire River Basin. These activities should be based on analysis of the environmental, social (including gender) and economic factors that cause or contribute to weed infestation and sedimentation in the Shire River, should target the drivers of land-use degradation in the Shire River Basin, and should be implemented in collaboration with other donors and stakeholders.
Capital of Malawi, Lilongwe
